editorial:
You know that feeling when you think a visit to your grandpa's house is going to be boring, and then it turns into the best night of your life? That is the heart of this fun little film. Set in 2050, a young wrestling fan dreads spending the night with his Grandfather, only to discover the old man once traveled the world interviewing some of the biggest wrestling stars ever. What follows is a warm, nostalgic trip through the lives of legends like Bill Goldberg, Bret Hart, Mike Tyson, Chris Jericho, and more. The sci-fi framing gives it a fresh twist, but the real magic is hearing these icons tell their own stories in their own words.

The pacing is easy and relaxed, letting each interview breathe without dragging. The mix of old footage and new conversations keeps things lively, and the grandfather-grandson bond adds real heart. Some segments feel a bit short, and a few stars get more screen time than others, but overall it is a treat for wrestling fans and a gentle entry point for newcomers. If you grew up watching these heroes, you will love it. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for your collection.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, the Grandfather finishes sharing his last interview story, and the young boy realizes his Grandfather is not just an old man but a keeper of wrestling history. The twist is that the Grandfather reveals he has one more tape hidden away, featuring a surprise legend he never told anyone about. The boy promises to carry on the tradition, and the film ends with the two of them watching the tape together, passing the torch from one generation to the next.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves wrestling history or stories about family bonds.
